text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide was defeated in the Japanese 
Derby. And she was left in awe that 
Winning Ticket, who had also lost, hadn't 
lost an ounce of her fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During the race, a future where she lost 
flashed before her eyes. Even now, she 
couldn't shake that image.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin and Winning Ticket. Was the 
reason they could surpass formulas because 
they possessed a "determination to become 
stronger" that she lacked?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling impatient, Biwa Hayahide requests 
high-intensity training to steel her own 
resolve. All so she won't lose in her next 
goal, the Kikuka Sho.
